steps: Strict-parse the frozen M72 JSON and verify 4 by 432 partitions, 16 unique 16-bit centers per partition.
SHA-check and unpack each of the 20 M40 heldout ternary plane files independently.
Rebuild the 3x3 convolution support geometry into 3000 output rows and 432 16-bit partitions per sample/operator.
Recompute nearest-center Hamming distance, fallback decision, PWP, correction, zero, onehot and matcher populations for all 8640 phases.
Recompute dense, bit-sparse and candidate service plus matcher, packer and next-phase DMA maxima for all three port configurations.
Recompute SRAM/DRAM traffic and buffer byte accounting from integer geometry.

output_block_factor_audit.dense_compute_equation: 25,920,000 partition vectors * 16 source bits * 8 output blocks = 3,317,760,000 vector cycles at one-cycle weight service
output_block_factor_audit.bit_sparse_compute_equation: 46,432,637 vector ops per block * 8 = 371,461,096 vector cycles
output_block_factor_audit.matcher_and_packer_not_multiplied_by_8_r: Assignments depend only on the 16-bit activation pattern and are reused by all eight output blocks; PWP/correction compute and SRAM bytes are multiplied by eight.

phase_overlap_attack.producer_rule: candidate phase = max(candidate compute, matcher, packer, next-partition DMA) + two-cycle tail
phase_overlap_attack.throughput_plausibility: Compute exceeds each individual matcher, packer and DMA service in every phase, with a minimum wide-port margin of 3224 cycles, so sustained overlap is plausible.
phase_overlap_attack.causal_proof_missing: No finite queue schedule, assignment-ready timing, pattern-index/PWP read dependency, downstream backpressure, RTL or assertion proof shows that matcher and packer results arrive early enough for compute to sustain the max envelope.
phase_overlap_attack.fully_serial_counterfactual: Even a deliberately pessimistic phase-serial counterfactual retains 1.4066x, 1.1517x and 1.2721x versus symmetric bit-sparse service for the wide, shared96 and shared32 configurations. This is a robustness bound, not measured RTL.

pwp_weight_and_traffic_audit.wide_port_requires: one 96-byte correction vector service cycle and one 144-byte PWP vector service cycle; candidate operations are serialized in the cycle equation
pwp_weight_and_traffic_audit.interpretation: PWP reuse reduces modeled SRAM read bytes by 25.54 percent but increases phase-prefetch DRAM bytes by 2.5x. The 144-byte PWP must never be counted as a 96-byte weight vector.

five_sample_prefetch_audit.why_not_one_global_prefetch: The modeled 60 KiB two-phase payload buffer cannot retain the 30.375 MiB all-PWP catalog across a complete sample. Sample-major execution therefore reloads each phase. A phase-major five-sample batching alternative would change activation buffering, ordering and latency and is not modeled.

buffer_capacity_audit.terminology: 36 KiB is only the PWP double buffer. 60 KiB is the combined weight-plus-PWP payload double buffer. They are not interchangeable totals.

valid825_boundary_attack.m40_population: first ten samples of local DSEC valid825, same validation sequence

dense_13p42x_claim_attack.assessment: 13.42x is arithmetically correct only against an all-16-source dense module baseline. About 8.93x already comes from the existing bit-sparse baseline. Presenting 13.42x as the new Phi-pattern hardware gain would be materially misleading; the new scoped gain is 1.21x to 1.50x before RTL/PPA and system composition.

minor_cycle_accounting_issue.impact: The dense denominator is short by 1920 cycles across five samples, changing the 13.4248357x figure only negligibly, but contradicting the exact same-scope wording and should be normalized in the next receipt.

accepted: Exact independent reproduction of M72 heldout partition work counts from frozen M40 planes
Exact independent reproduction of all three M76 arithmetic phase-max configurations and traffic totals
Isolated valid825-internal module DSE opportunity of 1.2136x to 1.5031x versus the modeled bit-sparse baseline
Output-block, PWP-byte, prefetch and payload-buffer integer accounting
not_admitted: full module SRAM capacity or macro feasibility
Synopsys timing, area, power or energy
training catalog, clean heldout accuracy or deployment accuracy
full-network/system cycles, FPS, energy efficiency or DATE headline

p1.finding: Matcher, packer and next-phase DMA are hidden by a phase max in all 8640 phases, but no finite queue/ready-valid schedule proves the assumed overlap.
p1.impact: The cycle totals are an optimistic throughput envelope rather than cycle-accurate module latency.
p1.minimal_fix: Implement a bounded event simulator or RTL with matcher-result, assignment-pack, PWP/correction issue and DMA queues; replay the same 8640 phase digest under backpressure.

p1.finding: The visually large 13.4248x compares against dense while the same trace already gives 8.9312x from bit sparsity; incremental M76 gain is 1.2136x to 1.5031x.
p1.impact: Using 13.42x as the new accelerator gain would overstate the Phi-style contribution.
p1.minimal_fix: Headline the equal-resource bit-sparse comparison and show dense only as a secondary normalization column.

p1.finding: The three abstract service widths have no banked SRAM macro, arbiter, timing, area or power realization; the wide arm requires 144-byte PWP service while a weight vector is 96 bytes.
p1.impact: The best 1.5031x arm may pay disproportionate SRAM port, mux and routing cost.
p1.minimal_fix: Build same-capacity 32B/96B/144B banked alternatives, then run DC/STA/Formality and workload SAIF/PTPX with macro-aware area and energy.

p1.finding: The reported 60 KiB is only two weight-plus-PWP phase payloads; it excludes the 54 KiB pattern table, queues, accumulators and banking overhead. The 36 KiB number is PWP-only.
p1.impact: Calling either number total module SRAM would understate local capacity and area.
p1.minimal_fix: Publish a complete byte ledger and macro packing for payload buffers, pattern table, assignment queues, accumulators, activation/descriptor state and ECC.

p1.finding: Centers use valid825 samples 0-4 and the holdout uses samples 5-9 from the same validation sequence; no PWP numerical values, 12-bit quantization or network inference accuracy is checked.
p1.impact: This cannot be a training catalog, independent accuracy result or deployable algorithm point.
p1.minimal_fix: Rebuild centers from disjoint training sequences, reserve sequence-disjoint hardware holdout, materialize 12-bit PWPs and run hardware-order valid825 plus task metrics.

p1.finding: The producer artifact is a writable development JSON without a root manifest/validator, and dense omits 1920 initial prefetch cycles that the other arms charge.
p1.impact: The current result is reproducible but not a citation-ready exact-scope release.
p1.minimal_fix: Normalize initial prefetch across all arms and seal simulator inputs, per-phase digest, output, validator and claim boundary in an immutable exact-SHA receipt.

scores.score_interpretation: The Phi-style PWP/correction mechanism is promising and the work/cycle arithmetic is unusually reproducible, but the mechanism is derivative, incremental speedup is modest-to-good rather than 13.42x, and the critical overlap/port/capacity/accuracy/physical evidence remains open.

go: Use M76 as an internally validated DSE and RTL prioritization input.
Prototype shared96 first for area realism and wide144 as a performance ceiling.
Preserve the exact 8640-phase digest for bounded-simulator and RTL replay.
no_go: No RTL-cycle, PPA, energy or system-speedup claim.
No training catalog, accuracy-preserving or independent-valid825 claim.
No DATE/best-paper promotion until P1 closure.

recommended_next_milestone.name: M76B bounded matcher-packer-PWP pipeline and same-resource port A/B
must_include: cycle ledger for all 8640 frozen phases with deterministic backpressure
same-capacity shared32, shared96 and wide144 macro/bank implementations
M40/M72 exact arithmetic replay and M76 traffic conservation
bit-sparse as the primary performance baseline
